elem.mep_fitting.derived: Fitting o'z trassalariga ergashadi: trassani o'zgartirsangiz, fitting ham o'zgaradi.
elem.mep_fitting.no_delete: Fittingni o'zi o'chirib yoki ko'chirib bo'lmaydi. Uning trassalarini tahrirlang yoki o'chiring.
elem.mep_fitting.hint: Trassalarini ko'rish uchun planda fittingni bosing.
